about: Art and sound that can replace the built-in (drawn in code) versions. Pass any of these in GameConfig.assets as { key: url }; anything missing falls back to the built-in version, so every game works with none of them. URLs must be on our own site (the CSP allows 'self', data: and blob: only).

assets.fallback: neon bokeh, perspective grid and spotlight

assets.size: 600x820 PNG/WebP; leave the prize window (48,284 to 552,648) plain
assets.fallback: drawn card face with barcode footer
drawn foil with the scratch hint

assets.size: short seamless loop, MP3/OGG under 60 KB

rules: Sounds stay off until the player turns them on.
No real people, no other companies' characters or logos.
A no-win sound must be neutral and never urge another go.
